|Hr = Journal
|Vigorous old knight and their noble companion, working together to see their lands cut free from haunted madness.<hr/>
They too seek the spectre at the Haunting's heart, though I fear that foe would pose a challenge beyond their mortal limits.

<b>Garmond and Zaza</b> are a pair of [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPCs]] and [[Bosses (Silksong)|bosses]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. A vigorous old knight and his noble companion, they are on a quest to [[the Citadel]] to avenge their home village after it was overtaken by the [[Haunting]].<ref>Garmond and Zaza Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Vigorous old knight and their noble companion, working together to see their lands cut free from haunted madness."</i></ref><ref name=dialog1/><ref name=dialog2/> The pair can be encountered in [[Pharloom]] battling haunted bugs and offering help to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], and in [[Act 2]], can optionally be dueled. [[Lost Garmond]] is Garmond's [[Black-Threading|black-threaded]] form.

== Background ==
Garmond is an old knight travelling with his companion, Zaza. They are the only survivors from their home village after it was overcome by the [[Haunting]].<ref name=dialog1>Garmond: <i>"The fearsome haunting of thread, it overcame our fair folk... We are all that remain, left to carry their memory, and the hope to see some justice paid."</i></ref> They seek [[the Citadel]] and its rulers in their quest for vengeance<ref name=dialog2>Garmond: <i>"We seek that Citadel not for its gifts. Nay, sister! We seek its rulers, to demand their answer! By force if necessary! For our dear village to whom we pledge our shells."</i></ref> while also aiming to defend [[Pharloom]]'s inhabitants from meeting a similar fate to those of their village.<ref>Garmond: <i>"Our fair village may have fallen, but for these fellows... these scared few, our honour charges us to keep them safe."</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
After first spotting [[Moorwing]], speaking to Garmond again prompts new dialogue. After this (or after entering Moorwing's arena), the two no longer appear in their original location, instead appearing in the area above the Moorwing fight, where talking to them gives the option to enlist their help in the boss battle.

The duo can also appear in [[Sinner's Road]] in the long room right above where [[Disgraced Chef Lugoli]] can be found, having beaten a [[Roachkeeper]] (permanently preventing that enemy from spawning). They appear here after opening and entering the room to the east of them.

Once [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] has defeated the [[Cogwork Dancers]], obtained the [[Clawline]], or activated the [[Bellshrine]] at [[Songclave]],<ref group=Source name=code>Flags related to <code>garmond</code> set in <code>GameManager.TimePasses()</code>.</ref> Garmond and Zaza sometimes appear to help fight enemies in hallway rooms in the [[Choral Chambers]].

If Hornet has spoken to Garmond at any point, opening the shortcut to the roof above the [[Whispering Vaults]] makes Garmond able to be met there<ref group=Source name=code/> – he offers to engage in a friendly duel with Hornet. If he is defeated, he and Zaza can be encountered again in [[High Halls]] outside the Forum, and offer to help Hornet do battle inside. It is possible to miss the chance to duel if Hornet does not speak to Garmond at any point during her travels, as once he has entered the Citadel he does not reappear in any rooms that he has been seen in before.

After Hornet has acquired the [[Threefold Melody]] and completed the <i>[[Fine Pins]]</i> [[Wish]],<ref group=Source name=code/> Garmond and Zaza can be found resting at Songclave and no longer ask to duel.

During [[Act 3]], Garmond and Zaza can be found in various areas on the path up to [[the Citadel]] ([[the Marrow]], [[Mosshome]], [[Far Fields]], [[Greymoor]], [[Sinner's Road]], [[Shellwood]], or [[Blasted Steps]]). Sitting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]] after an encounter causes them to become available to find in another location. After three encounters with them or obtaining the [[Everbloom]],<ref group=Source name=code/> they stop appearing and the <i>[[Hero's Call]]</i> Wish becomes active in [[Bellhart]].

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
{{AttackDisclaimer}}

Garmond and Zaza have the following moves as both allies and opponents:

* <b>Hornlance Sweep</b>: Zaza stands still while Garmond swings his hornlance back and forth 5 times, making large arcs above him.
* <b>Gallant Joust</b>: Garmond readies his hornlance and the two charge towards his current opponent, continuing until they reach the edge of the arena platform.
* <b>Cavalier Drop</b>: Zaza makes a tall leap towards their opponent at a short set distance. At the apex of the jump, Garmond stabs downwards with his hornlance straight into the ground.
* <b>Charge</b>: Zaza runs towards their opponent to reposition for an attack.

In battle against other foes, Garmond attempts to block enemy attacks or projectiles with his hornlance. After blocking 20 times, both he and Zaza become stunned and fall over. They recover after 6 seconds, or immediately if Hornet [[Bind|Binds]] near them.

While dueling Garmond and Zaza, they can be knocked off the arena platform into the adjacent spikes, which deals 30 damage to them before they leap back onto the platform.

Losing to Garmond and Zaza in their friendly duel does not result in a save file loss in {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]]. However, dying by being knocked into the spikes below the arena '''does'''.

== Locations ==
They can be first met in [[Greymoor]], in a small outcropping to the upper left of the [[Bellway]] Station. They can also be seen briefly in [[Sinner's Road]], in the long room right above where [[Disgraced Chef Lugoli]] can be found, having beaten a [[Roachkeeper]].

==Creation and Development==
[[File:Garmond and Zaza reveal trailer.png|thumb|250px|Garmond and Zaza in the reveal trailer]]
Garmond and Zaza are inspired by Don Quixote and his horse respectively, characters from the 1600s novel ''Don Quixote''.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mtCjcqixHTE&t=4511s Hollow Knight: Silksong | Voice of Garmond Plays | Part 14 | 9.22.25] (1:19:15):<i> "When they first gave me the the description of his character, they were like, "He's kind of like a Don Quixote."</i></ref> Initially, Garmond's placeholder name was "Bitterbug", likely in reference to his future voice actor BitterBits.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FuW_l3_SUVg Origin Stories - EP03 Bitter Bits] (2:09:29): <i>"[...] his name wasn't Garmond at the time. His name was Bitterbug."</i></ref> This name is still used internally in places.<ref><code>Bitterbug</code> sound folder in the game files.</ref> Prior to ''Silksong''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s formal announcement in February 2019, Team Cherry reached out to BitterBits, offering him the role of voicing Garmond, which he accepted.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FuW_l3_SUVg Origin Stories - EP03 Bitter Bits] (2:08:39): "''I remember them sending me an email and they were like "we'd like you to voice this character."''."</ref> Some of BitterBits' voice lines that he sent became unused outakes.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ceKT-oNbx_A Hollow Knight: Silksong <nowiki>|</nowiki> Voice of Garmond Plays <nowiki>|</nowiki> Part 1 <nowiki>|</nowiki> 9.04.25] (28:44): "''There's, um, maybe maybe one day we can listen to some of the like based off of what they did end up using and then some of the outtake stuff is probably pretty stupid.''"</ref>

Garmond and Zaza were first revealed in the <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer, where they appeared in a Greymoor room that they do not appear in currently.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref> In March 2019, they were formally described in a blog post as "''A rambunctious older bug and his noble steed, on a quest to discover a new home. Garmond may be the chattier of the two, but Zaza could be the real brains of the pair.''"<ref>[https://www.teamcherry.com.au/blog/hk-physical-late-anniversary-celebration-silksong-mini-update Team Cherry blog post] of March 19th, 2019</ref> In February 2021's <i>EDGE Magazine</i> issue, Garmond and Zaza's ability to assist in the Moorwing battle was shown.<ref name="edge58">[https://pocketmags.com/edge-magazine/february-2021 Edge Magazine February 2021 edition], p. 58.</ref> Around June 2025, BitterBits re-recorded his lines in preperation for the upcoming release of ''Silksong''.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ceKT-oNbx_A Hollow Knight: Silksong <nowiki>|</nowiki> Voice of Garmond Plays <nowiki>|</nowiki> Part 1 <nowiki>|</nowiki> 9.04.25] (36:35): "''The second to last pass on the on Garmond's lines. Uh that was when we were doing AI limit''".</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FuW_l3_SUVg Origin Stories - EP03 Bitter Bits] (2:10:06): "''I actually ended up re-recording all of his lines, I think, in uh, it was like earlier this year. Um, probably around like June or something like that.''"</ref> They were at some point planned to appear in <code>Song_01</code>, a room in the Choral Chambers.<ref><code>garmondInSong01</code></ref><ref><code>garmondSeenInSong01</code></ref>

== Trivia ==
* After enlisting Garmond and Zaza's help in the [[Moorwing]] fight, if the game is exited and then re-entered, the two stop appearing, and they need to be spoken with again to rejoin the fight.
* Garmond and Zaza can defeat Moorwing without outside help from Hornet.
* If an enemy is lured to Garmond and Zaza outside of when they are fighting, they will remain in place and continuously perform Hornlance Sweep.
* Despite not being haunted, Garmond still willingly pauses mid-battle (either with enemies or while sparring with Hornet) to sing if the Needolin is played.
* While this behaviour is not present in their duel, if a projectile hits Garmond, he will block it using his hornlance.
